testConditions.measuredFrom: static assets referenced by prerendered HTML when present, or by per-route client-reference manifests for dynamic app routes, resolved against real file sizes in .next/static after `next build`

vitals.device: mid-tier mobile CPU throttling, 4x slowdown (Lighthouse 'mobile' preset)
vitals.network: Simulated Slow 4G — 1.6 Mbps down / 750 Kbps up / 150ms RTT
vitals.measurementNote: LCP, CLS, and interaction-latency targets below are documented audit targets for manual/periodic Lighthouse runs against a production build, and are corroborated by real user data from the WebVitalsReporter diagnostics (see lib/diagnostics). They are not machine-gated in CI in this change — see scripts/performance/README.md for why.

/developers/api-keys.note: Authenticated API-key management loads form validation libraries on the client; this is isolated from public routes.

/proofs.note: Higher JS budget than public routes is intentional: the proof creation surfaces load @stellar/freighter-api on demand (dynamic import) when the worker clicks 'Connect Freighter', not in the route's first load JS. See scripts/performance/README.md for the bundle evidence.

/proofs/payment-receipt.note: Authenticated payment-receipt proof creation loads zod-backed client validation.

/proofs/recurring-income.note: Authenticated recurring-income proof creation loads zod-backed client validation.

/settings/issuers.note: Authenticated issuer management loads react-hook-form and zod-backed client validation.

/settings/organizations.note: Authenticated organization management loads react-hook-form and zod-backed client validation.
